summary: The article explains that Brock Purdy, the San Francisco 49ers quarterback, carries the nickname "Mr. Irrelevant" because he was the final pick (No. 262) of the 2022 NFL Draft, a tradition dating to 1976. It recounts his strong rookie run and 5-0 start to 2023, then grades the eight quarterbacks drafted ahead of him, concluding that Purdy (A+) has had the best career of the class.
one_line: Brock Purdy is called Mr. Irrelevant as the last pick of the 2022 NFL Draft, yet he has outperformed every quarterback drafted before him.
key_facts: "Mr. Irrelevant" is the nickname given to the final pick of the NFL Draft, a staple since the 1976 Draft.
Brock Purdy, an Iowa State alum, was the 2022 Mr. Irrelevant, taken at Pick 262 by the San Francisco 49ers.
Purdy was the first Mr. Irrelevant to make a forward pass successfully in a regular season game.
Purdy finished his rookie season with five consecutive regular-season victories, completing a 10-game winning streak by San Francisco.
Purdy led the 49ers to the NFC Championship Game against the Philadelphia Eagles, where he got hurt and the team fell short of a Super Bowl LVII appearance.
Purdy opened the 2023 season 5-0; the 49ers and Eagles were the only unbeaten teams at the time.
Eight quarterbacks were drafted before Purdy: Kenny Pickett, Desmond Ridder, Malik Willis, Matt Corral, Bailey Zappe, Sam Howell, Chris Oladokun and Skylar Thompson.
Kenny Pickett (Steelers, Pick 20) and Sam Howell (Commanders, Pick 144) each received a B grade.
Desmond Ridder (Falcons, Pick 74) earned a C and became the Falcons' starter ahead of 2023.
Malik Willis (Titans, Pick 86) got a D as the Titans drafted Will Levis to replace him.
Matt Corral (Panthers, Pick 94) got an E; the Panthers traded up to number one for Bryce Young in 2023 and Corral left the team.
Chris Oladokun (Pick 241) received an F, has not made an NFL start and was waived by the Steelers.
The article gives Purdy an A+, calling him arguably the best Mr. Irrelevant of all time and floating a comparison to Tom Brady.
